intro: Peru is a presidential republic that has seen frequent political crises.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for five years. Congress can remove a president for 'moral incapacity', and it has done so several times. Elections were held in 2026.

chapters.title: Congress
text: From 2026 Congress has two chambers again, a Senate and a Chamber of Deputies.
